summary.text: GAH EIENDOM AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2016-06-17. GAH EIENDOM AS engages in the purchase, sale, development, operation and leasing of real estate. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 22 734 012 NOK and the annual result was 6 518 849 NOK; operating income was up from 22 073 081 NOK in 2024.
